metadata.title: feat(ui): Improve sidebar TeamSwitcher with Globe icon and theme support
metadata.author: vishu-bh

description:
## Summary
This PR improves the sidebar TeamSwitcher component with better visual design and theme support.

## Changes
- **TeamSwitcher Component**: Replace BookOpen icon with Globe icon, reduce size, remove background styling
- **Sidebar Layout**: Restructure header to show NavIcon → SidebarTrigger → TeamSwitcher in same line
- **Theme Support**: Update icon components (PromptIcon, GatewayIcon, MCPIcon) to use `currentColor` for proper light/dark theme adaptation
- **Collapse Behavior**: Fix TeamSwitcher to properly hide when sidebar is collapsed

## Visual Changes
- Globe icon replaces BookOpen icon throughout TeamSwitcher
- Smaller, cleaner appearance (button size reduced from lg to default)
- All icons now properly follow theme colors in both light and dark modes

## Testing
- ✅ Linting passed (ESLint)
- ✅ Formatting verified (Prettier)
- ✅ All icon components use theme-aware colors

Closes #[issue-number-if-applicable]

commits.message:
feat(ui): improve sidebar TeamSwitcher with Globe icon and theme support

- Replace BookOpen icon with Globe icon in TeamSwitcher
- Reduce TeamSwitcher size (button: lg→default, container: size-8→size-6)
- Remove background styling for cleaner appearance
- Add theme-aware colors for light/dark mode support
- Fix sidebar collapse behavior to properly hide TeamSwitcher
- Restructure Sidebar header layout (NavIcon → SidebarTrigger → TeamSwitcher)
- Update icon components to use currentColor for theme compatibility:
  - PromptIcon: stroke color now follows theme
  - GatewayIcon: simplified structure with theme support
  - MCPIcon: updated dimensions and theme-aware colors

All changes ensure proper adaptation to light and dark themes.

Signed-off-by: Vishu Bhatnagar <vishu.bhatnagar@ibm.com>

commits.message:
fix: restore mobile sidebar trigger in Header

The SidebarTrigger was moved inside the Sidebar component, making it
inaccessible on mobile where the sidebar is rendered in a closed Sheet.

Changes:
- Add SidebarTrigger to Header, visible only on mobile (md:hidden)
- Change Header layout from justify-end to justify-between
- Import SidebarTrigger from ui/sidebar

This fixes the mobile sidebar accessibility issue while maintaining
the desktop experience where the trigger is inside the sidebar.

Fixes requested changes in PR #4531

feat: add accessibility attributes to TeamSwitcher

Enhance TeamSwitcher component with comprehensive ARIA attributes for
improved screen reader support and keyboard navigation:

- Add aria-label to trigger button indicating current selection
- Add aria-haspopup and aria-expanded for dropdown state

- Add role="alert" to error messages for immediate announcement
- Add role="status" to empty state messages
- Add aria-label to each menu item with team name and description
- Add aria-current to indicate currently selected team

commits.message:
perf: optimize TeamSwitcher re-renders with memoization

Prevent unnecessary re-renders when selecting teams by memoizing
computed values and callbacks:

- Memoize teams array to prevent recreation on every render
- Memoize currentTeam lookup to avoid redundant find operations
- Use useCallback for handleSelectTeam to maintain referential equality
- Replace inline arrow functions with memoized callback

Performance improvements:
- Reduces re-renders when teams data doesn't change
- Prevents recreation of event handlers on each render
- Optimizes team lookup with dependency tracking

All tests passing:
- Unit tests: 8 passed
- E2E tests: 2 passed

Related to PR #4531
